violations.why: irq_velvet (priority 4) can preempt irq_loom between its read and write of v_ember, so the increment is lost.
irq_velvet can preempt irq_loom after it writes v_ember and reset it to 0, so the check at line 21 sees a different value.
irq_velvet can change v_ember between the read at line 20 and the read at line 21.
irq_loom (priority 3) can preempt irq_bluff (priority 2) between its write and its check, and it changes v_ember.
irq_reef (priority 3) can preempt irq_bluff after its write and set v_ember to 1, so the check at line 29 fails.
irq_velvet (priority 4) can preempt irq_bluff between its write and its check and write v_ember.
